readout_other: soleus EMG; SEPs and MEPs; BBB locomotor score; c-fos, GAD65, GFAP, caspase-3, Bcl-2, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha; H&E and Nissl staining
direction_notes: Spinal cord LIFU above 0.5 MPa evoked soleus EMG and increased c-fos and GAD65-positive cells; 3.0 MPa reduced SEP amplitude and caused dorsal horn necrosis.
safety_notes: Up to 1.5 MPa no change in BBB score, SEP/MEP latency, histology or inflammatory markers; 3.0 MPa caused coagulation necrosis and increased IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, GFAP and caspase-3.

target.label: lumbar 4-lumbar 5 (L4-L5) segments of the spinal cord

timing.protocol_description: Study I: 1 s ON / 4 s OFF stimulation per pressure level (20 s each) with 5 min between levels. Study II: 20 min of LIFU at 0, 0.5, 1.5 or 3.0 MPa. Each pulse was 800 cycles at 4 MHz.
